El FTP es la potencia más alta que puede: FTP is the highest power you can sustain for about an hour. It is estimated as 95 percent of your best 20-minute average. ¿Tienes medidor de potencia o sensor de: Have a power meter or cadence sensor? Pair it in Settings › Bluetooth on the watch and HÅLSYN will use it automatically. Indoors, there's no distance without a speed sensor.
¿Tienes una balanza Xiaomi? En la app Ze: Have a Xiaomi scale? In the Zepp Life (or Mi Fit) app: Profile › Add accounts › Apple Health, and turn on weight and body fat. Other smart scales have a similar option.
Última milla a %@ millas por hora: Last mile at %@ miles per hour
Último kilómetro a %@ kilómetros por hor: Last kilometer at %@ kilometers per hour
Último peso registrado en Apple Health,: Latest weight recorded in Apple Health, for example from a connected scale. Weight changes 1–2 kg from day to day due to water and food: look at the trend over weeks.
